manual_notes: Tree-bridge scanning, similarity filtering, deduplication, batch judgments and merge-before-parent execution are implemented in the historical patch. The required skip of every pair involving an already merged tag is not fully supported: skipSet is local to a batch and is checked only in the parent loop, not the merge loop. Later inspected snapshots no longer contain this implementation. Historical delivery of the full safety contract remains uncertain.
